items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we go way back. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, we do. ... it’s good to see you.

ctx.x: Sam was interviewed in Clinton, NY on May 27, 2011 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m really pleased to have Sam Kininger here, and, we go way back.
Yes, we do. I’m very pleased to be here, by the way, it’s good to see you.
